title: SillySMP Title Addons
description: SillySMP Panoramas and server-derived splash text!
body:
### **About:**

This is a resource pack that changes the "minecraft" and "edition" labels, adds panoramas from the SillySMP, as well as splash text derived from past quotes from its members.

**Splash text does contain swearing.**

**One Dependancy:**

Please make sure you have [Panorandom](https://modrinth.com/mod/panorandom) installed as well. The image file names are written to work with that mod.

![!Stacked preview of the individual panorama image files, with the updated title and edition image edited on top.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49fcad76321a4fc14e9fd94f74b4952c24f5a371.jpeg)

**Primary Audience:**

This resource pack is made specifically for other members of the SillySMP, but uhhh if you want this as well, you're free to have it!

**Future Updates:**

Added panoramas and splash text are likely.
